# Juan Manuel — K4zzu

> Personal portfolio of Juan Manuel (K4zzu), a developer working across software and electronics: automation, security and creative web. The page is drawn as animated ASCII art (a black hole, a star system and a ringed planet).

## Projects

- [MoonSite](https://github.com/K4zzu/MoonSite): lunar landing site navigator built for the NASA Space Apps lunar south-pole challenge. Live: https://moonsite.whatbrainy.com
- [Rinnegan](https://github.com/K4zzu/Rinnegan): terminal-style OSINT web app with a FastAPI backend. Live: https://k4zzu.github.io/Rinnegan/
- [Nutripae](https://github.com/K4zzu/Nutripae): balanced-plate check for the school meal programme (PAE) in Neiva.
- [Nfc_PokeDex](https://github.com/K4zzu/Nfc_PokeDex): Pokédex that registers Pokémon by scanning NFC tags from the browser. Live: https://k4zzu.github.io/Nfc_PokeDex/
